t1.result: {"path":"investigate","reasoning":"The request was a diagnosis (\"look into this error: TypeError in formatDate\"), so I investigated and made no edits. Cause, from reading the code: src/utils/formatDate.js:5 calls date.toISOString() with no null guard, and src/api/orders.js:12 passes order.shippedAt, which is null for unshipped orders (tests/fixtures/orders.json ORD-1002). Result: TypeError \"Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toISOString')\", unhandled in the handler. Same exposure in src/services/invoice.ts:7, where dueAt is Date | null. The bug report's line 6 is stale; the current call is on line 5. README says formatDate throws on null, so the fix is either caller-side null handling or changing formatDate's contract. Gaps: no formatDate test exists (tests/ has only quantity.test.js), and I could not run the reproduction or npm test because Bash was denied in don't-ask mode. Reproduction is static only."}
